description: This file defines a function 'taskMetadata' that gathers and processes metadata related to a task, including message handling, directory size calculation, and token usage metrics. It exports a type 'TaskMetadataOptions' for input parameters and uses various imported utilities and types.

classes.name: TaskMetadataOptions
classes.description: Type defining options for the taskMetadata function, including task identifiers, messages, storage paths, and optional parameters like mode, apiConfigName, initialStatus, and toolProtocol.

methods.name: taskMetadata
methods.description: Asynchronously gathers metadata for a specified task, including message processing, directory size, and token metrics, returning an object with a history item and token usage details.
